source_en: What a beautiful morning! Ivan Tarkov, factory worker, east side.
I keep a list of every officer I meet. You're number nine!
I have many! Collecting, counting, arranging. You have lovely cheekbones.
The alleys by the factory are so quiet since curfew.
Oh, always the bag! You never know what you'll find.
I'm never alone! I'm very good company.
Papers! All in order. I'll see you soon.
